sentences.text: This pterosaur had a wingspan of about 2 meters.
Its humerus, or upper arm bone, measured 88 mm in length and possessed a low deltopectoral crest without a pneumatic foramen.
Although the pelvis is heavily damaged, a femur fragment with an estimated length of 91 mm remains.
The genus Longchengpterus was named in 2006 by Wang Li, Li Li, Duan Ye, and Cheng Shao-li.
The genus name combines the old name of Chaoyang City, Longcheng, with the Greek word for wing.
The species name zhaoi honors Zhao Dayu, president of Shenyang Normal University and a founder of the Western Liaoning Institute of Mesozoic Paleontology.
The holotype specimen LPM 00023, found at Yuanjiawa near Dapingfanga, consists of a compressed incomplete skeleton and partial skull preserved on a single plate.
Longchengpterus is part of the superfamily Ornithocheiroidea.
It belongs to the family Istiodactylidae.
This classification is based on shared tooth form, tooth count, and a large skull opening with Istiodactylus.
A notable difference between Longchengpterus and Istiodactylus is the lack of a broad snout in Longchengpterus.
Longchengpterus lived during the Barremian to Aptian stages of the Early Cretaceous in the Jiufotang Formation of Chaoyang, Liaoning, China.
Fossils of Longchengpterus date back approximately 120 million years.
The time range for Longchengpterus is estimated between 121.4 and 113.2 million years ago.
